dashboard.title: Training needs identification platform
dashboard.instructions1: Let us plan your technicians' training together to support the growth of your business.
dashboard.instructions2: For each brand, select the training topic and state how many people are concerned as well as the preferred training location.
dashboard.instructions3: If you would like the training to take place within your subsidiary, we will get back to you to schedule it.
dashboard.deadlineAfter: So that we can build the training catalogues brand by brand and share them with you afterwards.
dashboard.contact: We remain at your disposal for any further information on {phone}.

section.CARROSSERIEHint: These courses are not brand-specific: they cover bodywork repair on every vehicle.
section.PROCESS: Aftersales Process and Parts organisation training
section.PROCESSHint: Training on aftersales and parts department organisation, for Motors and Equipment.
